title: Machine generator characterization gaps before expansion
summary: At generator fdea3ff, 960 frame cases repeat deterministically in native canvas. Finite 48-unit overscan finds out-of-frame content in heavy, crawler, archive and drone action combinations. Analytical idle/walk endpoints can differ. Hexapod/archive battle strips reach 6528px width. Current arbitrary-target legIK violates segment lengths outside its reach domain. Existing valid-pose tests did not cover these domains. Probe script and full output are archived; diagnostics are not art approval.

reviews.evidence: Ran archived audit-generator.mjs against fdea3ff: 960 cases with zero repeated-render hash mismatches; finite overscan and loop endpoint findings logged; battle widths 6528px; reachable and unreachable legIK probes recorded. Full output generator-audit.json at fb1f254. Characterization is tested; identified production gaps remain unfixed.
